agent_input.campaign_goal: Develop a falsifiable research plan for diagnosing a generalization gap in a tabular classification workflow.

public_task.context: A model has a higher score on training data than on a held-out development split. No row-level data, scores, feature list, or model details are provided.
public_task.question: Propose up to three distinct, falsifiable hypotheses that could explain the gap. Select one hypothesis and specify a small next experiment, the expected evidence, and a condition that would falsify it. Do not claim that any experiment has already been run; identify missing information as a limitation.
constraints: Do not assume a particular dataset or model.
Prefer a low-cost diagnostic that does not inspect a final test or holdout set.
